headline: Europe's leaders have given up the race to build the most advanced frontier AI models, POLITICO Europe reports.
score_reason: Lowered from the pool score of 6: a sweeping claim from one outlet with no detail available to check, so it is held at 5 until the leaders and the decision are known.
importance_line: If the report is right, European businesses, researchers and governments could come to rely on American or Chinese models for the most advanced AI, but which leaders decided what, and when, is not known, so the claim is unconfirmed.
summary: POLITICO Europe reports, in a story titled "Europe's leaders abandon the race for frontier AI", that European leaders are giving up the race to build frontier AI, meaning the most advanced and powerful AI models.
notes: POLITICO Europe page gave HTTP 403 and no other outlet carrying the story was found (three Google News searches). Entry rests on the title only. The editor should treat the claim as unconfirmed.
